2126028463840677905.en_summary: More fun facts/estimates: Consensus sees median S&P 500 EPS growth slowing modestly from 13% in 2026 to 10% in 2027, as a sharp Tech/Mag 7 deceleration (30% to 19%) is cushioned by steadier growth across the rest of the index (11% to 9%).
2126028463840677905.zh_summary: 更多有趣的事實/估計：共識認為S&P 500的中位數EPS增長將從2026年的13%溫和放緩至2027年的10%，因為科技/Mag 7的急劇減速（30%至19%）被指數其餘部分更穩定的增長（11%至9%）所緩衝。

2126024963832615420.en_summary: Qatar's LNG exports are making a comeback. Average daily tanker departures from Ras Laffan have surged nearly 10-fold, from 0.15 in May to 1.45 in November. But they're still 48% below February's 2.8 ships/day. The recovery is far from complete.
2126024963832615420.zh_summary: 卡塔爾的LNG出口正在復甦。從Ras Laffan的平均每日油輪離港量激增近10倍，從5月的0.15增至11月的1.45。但它們仍比 2月的每天2.8艘低48%。復甦遠未完成。
